jobs.description: Job Title: Lead Technical Program Manager - Activision Requisition ID: R028027 Job Description: Your Mission Publishing’s Data and Analytics Engineering team builds and operates the data products, pipelines, and integrations that turn trusted data into action across our Studios, Analytics, Product, Finance, and Marketing Technology ecosystem. We are looking for a Lead Technical Project Manager to serve as the connective layer across these disciplines - bringing structure to ambiguous problems, translating business priorities into executable technical plans, and driving complex initiatives from intake through launch. This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who combines strong program leadership with practical data and software fluency. You will partner closely with data engineers, analytics engineers, product and business leaders, and platform teams to align priorities, manage dependencies, resolve issues, and ensure our solutions are reliable, scalable, and useful. This role is based in our Los Angeles (Pen Factory) office and follows an onsite work schedule of Monday through Thursday. Work arrangements may change at the company’s discretion to meet business needs. What You Bring to the Table Priorities can shift quickly in a fast-paced environment, so this role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities: Own end-to-end planning and delivery across a portfolio of data activation, analytics engineering, and data platform integration initiatives. Serve as the program lead across Studios, Analytics, Finance, Marketing Technology, and engineering teams—clarifying goals, requirements, ownership, dependencies, and success measures. Partner with engineering and product leadership to shape roadmaps, sequence work, and align team capacity with business priorities and customer commitments. Perform SQL-based validation or optimization and first-pass troubleshooting to accelerate issue resolution and route deeper investigation effectively. Drive execution across concurrent workstreams by managing milestones, risks, trade-offs, decisions, release coordination, migrations, and operational readiness. Use technical expertise to understand data flows, schemas, APIs, models, and system integrations. Establish scalable operating mechanisms for intake, prioritization, status reporting, decision logs, documentation, service ownership, and governance-related workflows. Communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly to engineering teams, business partners, and senior leaders, tailoring the level of detail to the audience. Define and track meaningful outcomes—including adoption, data quality, reliability, timeliness, and delivery predictability—and use retrospectives to improve how teams work together. Player Profile 7+ years of technical program, product, or project management experience working directly with data, software, platform, or infrastructure engineering teams. Prior hands-on experience as a data analyst/engineer, technical analyst, or another technical individual contributor is strongly preferred; equivalent technical depth is also welcome. Working proficiency with SQL, including the ability to inspect schemas, validate outputs, investigate data quality issues, and govern access. Practical understanding of the data lifecycle, including ingestion, transformation, orchestration, batch and streaming pipelines, APIs, semantic or metrics layers, and downstream activation. Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs across multiple teams and organizations while navigating ambiguity and evolving priorities. Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical concepts, constraints, and trade-offs for non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership. Exceptional prioritization, time management, and follow-through, with a bias toward action and the ability to distinguish urgent work from important long-term investments. Experience with Jira, Confluence, Slack, M365, or similar collaboration tools, and comfort working across Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery models. AI fluency, including experience supporting AI/ML programs or using AI-assisted tools to improve planning, documentation, QA, incident analysis, or self-service data access. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Experience with data activation or Marketing Technology ecosystems, including customer data platforms, reverse ETL, identity resolution, campaign platforms, experimentation, or measurement and conversion APIs. COMPANY OVERVIEW
KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
KKR's Gurugram office provides best-in-class business operations services and solutions to our internal stakeholders and clients, drives organization-wide process efficiency and transformation, and reflects KKR's global culture and values of teamwork and innovation. The office contains multifunctional business capabilities and is integral in furthering the growth and transformation of KKR. The office was established with an initial concentration of finance, operations, and technology personnel, followed by the expansion of additional functions and capabilities. KKR’s creation of a Gurugram office builds upon the firm's momentum in India and bolsters its existing presence in Mumbai.
TEAM OVERVIEW
Finance supports the strategic direction of the Firm by ensuring efficient and effective financial planning, analysis, budgeting, reporting, compliance, accounting, and stewardship of financial risks and controls. By doing so, we produce accurate financial information for decision making, ensure compliance with financial regulations and policies, and provide leadership for operational improvements, cost savings and strategic investments that align with the Firm’s culture and long-term goals.
POSITION SUMMARY
The role is responsible for the preparation, analysis, and dissemination of financial and operational information for the private equity fund.
ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES
Operational Excellence
• Collect and analyze financial data from various sources and prepare periodic reports for investors and stakeholders.
• Present the fund's performance and financial position.
• Ensure the reports are accurate, complete and in compliance with regulatory requirements.
• Generate reports from Investran, match opening balances with previous quarter closing balances, current activities, perform accuracy checks on all the reports.
• Conduct monthly partner transfers by identifying all partner transfers during the month from the transfer sheet, generating reports to identify any transfers that need to be adjusted, making partner transfer adjustment entries in Investran and regenerate reports to check adjustments flowing correctly in the reports.
• Prepare quarterly deal by generating reports (Balance and GAAP Financial statements), match opening balances with previous quarter closing balances, current activities, formatting as per guidelines, checking accuracy of all the reports.
• Prepare pdf package for the generated and checked reports.
• Generate quarterly fund expenses report by passing the JE as per fund receivable handoff received, match opening & closing balances, perform checks for the figures.
• Generate quarterly FX contracts report by passing the JE as per foreign currency exchange contracts handoffs, match opening & closing balances, and perform checks for the figures.
• Generate quarterly management fees report by passing the JE as per management fee handoff received, match opening & closing balances, perform checks for the figures.
Stakeholder Management
• Collaborate with team members of the private equity team, such as portfolio managers and investment professionals, to gather and review relevant data for reporting purposes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure that reports accurately reflect the fund's activities and performance.
Reporting & Governance
• Run MPI reports and reconcile it with Grants and Forfeit support
• Reconcile balances/activities with prior year, Q4 rolls and support
QUALIFICATIONS
• Bachelor’s degree in commerce or equivalent work
• Chartered Accountant / CFA
• 6-9 years of experience in fund reporting, accounting or finance
• Experience in preparing regular financial reports for private equity funds, including NAV, performance reports, and presentations
• Knowledge of fund accounting principles and the ability to maintain accurate and up-to-date capital account records
• Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations governing private equity funds and the ability to ensure compliance with all relevant requirements
• Ability to perform complex financial analysis and modelling
• Ability to communicate regularly with investors and provide updates on fund performance
• Proficiency in financial reporting software and systems, such as Bloomberg, etc.
• Ability to manage large amounts of data accurately and efficiently
• Systems/ Tools/ Applications knowledge:
- Highly proficient in MS Excel
- Investran
• Displays high intellectual curiosity and innovative mindset
• Demonstrates highest levels of integrity
• Focus on delivery excellence and accountability
• Build strong relationships with local and global colleagues
• Displays behaviors of self-reliance
• Demonstrates a relationship-driven mindset

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
팀 소개
Selection Strategy Operation팀은 마켓에서의 고객의 수요가 높은 상품을 타겟팅 및 분석하는 팀입니다. 마켓 데이터를 바탕으로 구체적인 Selection 계획을 수립하고, 이를 위한 타겟 Pool을 선정하여 우선 순위를 제공합니다. 쿠팡 Retail Selection의 빠른 확장을 위한 Category별로 기준을 운영합니다. 효율적인 Retail Selection 타겟을 확보하기 위하여 프로세스를 수립하고, 개선합니다.
직무 소개
Selection Strategy Operation은 고객 수요와 시장 데이터를 기반으로 쿠팡 Retail Selection의 성장 전략을 수립하고 실행하는 조직입니다. 본 역할은 데이터 기반의 의사결정을 통해 Selection 확대를 주도하고, Selection Identification운영의 프로세스를 설계하고 개선하며, 다양한 이해관계자와의 협업을 통해 비즈니스 목표 달성을 지원합니다. 타겟팅 고도화, 운영 표준화 및 Playbook 구축을 통해 조직의 실행력을 높이고, 신규 비즈니스 및 카테고리 확장 과정에서 핵심적인 역할을 수행하게 됩니다.
업무 내용
주요 제조사 및 Brand사 등의 마켓조사를 통한 Sourcing 전략을 제시하고 비즈니스 우선순위를 고려하여 Brand, Selection 타겟 선정 및 제공

데이터 기반으로 프로세스 병목을 제거하고 Insight 도출을 통해 셀렉션 프로세스의 관리 및 개선안을 제시

jobs.description: Amazon is looking for a detail-oriented individual to join our Data Center Engineering Operations (DCEO) Team. You will serves as an expert technical resource reporting to the cluster leadership and interacting with onsite Engineering Operations Technicians (EOT), Chief Engineers (CE), Facility Managers (FM) and any third party vendors. Being the singular focal point for all facility operations within a given data center, you will support Amazon within its owned and operated data centers. Data center equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. As the Senior Chief Engineer you will manage small-to-medium impacting projects at local and/or regional level from conception to completion. These projects involve large amounts of independent work as well as collaboration with external support groups including engineering, automation, processing, and finance in both local and global settings. Creating and delivering on key milestones, obtaining and tracking quotes for all necessary costs, and documenting project results for future implementation at other facilities. The goals of such projects are for the CE to drive innovation and resiliency while reducing operational costs in the facilities. One of the best parts to this role is that you will direct, train and support Engineering Operation Technicians in their role of providing hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operations. jobs.description: Would you like to be part of an ISV sales team focused on transforming education alongside the most prominent ISV companies in the global Education market? Our EdTech ISV sales team supports the largest and most impactful Education Technology companies in the world as they strive to transform learning experiences and outcomes through application of AI and emerging technologies. We are looking for an Account Manager to work closely with a named set of enterprise EdTech ISV customers to drive growth and innovation with them. You will be responsible for establishing and fostering relationships, while generating and launching new opportunities across multiple accounts. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong bias for action, customer obsession, and a track record of consistently delivering results. This individual should possess both a sales and technical background that enables them to earn trust at the CXO level, various business stakeholders (Product, Finance, etc.), as well as with software developers, engineers, and IT architects. Come join our team and help us transform the way we learn, teach, and develop the next generation of students and professionals. Key job responsibilities Collaborate across all levels of the customer's organization, from C-suite executives to engineering, product management, and sales. Success in this role requires creative systems thinking and the ability to build relationships throughout the account. You'll execute collaboratively with extended teams to address the full spectrum of ISV customer needs. As an AWS Account Manager, you'll own the strategic relationship and develop comprehensive strategies for customer adoption and AWS service deployment. Working hand-in-hand with AWS resources, including executives, partners, support teams, and solution architects. You will champion customer interests while balancing business objectives. This includes dotted-line responsibility for driving partnership and technical collaboration across the organization. - Drive adoption of AWS’ full suite of services into a portfolio of enterprise ISV customers - Exceed annual revenue and design win targets - Drive levers for growth of the business: inclusive of Account Plans, GTM programs to drive adoption of our ISV partners’ products, working closely with marketing and the partner teams - In partnership with Sales Ops, manage all operational aspects of the business; SFDC, etc. - Develop long-term strategic relationships with AWS Executives and Partner management teams - Embrace and drive the Amazon culture; lead through our Leadership Principles About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
